seed: A recording that opens straight into Edit comes up fitted into the room above the tool bar, the transport and the timeline, the way it does after a switch from View to Edit. Before 2026-10-15 it came up at 99%, with its lower part under the tool bar, the transport and the timeline. At Next defaults with no flag set: the Cut a recording down guide's sample, then that recording cut once, saved as a project, closed and opened again, and every time the whole picture ends above the tool bar. A small picture with no time still opens at 100%.

steps.note: THE TEST: the guide's recording opened straight into Edit with the tracks up, and the whole picture sits above the tool bar, not at 99% running under it and the transport
THE TEST: a recording somebody already cut, opened again: it comes back in Edit, fitted above the tool bar and the timeline
a picture with no time that the window can hold still opens at 100%
